2645-3430-4348-7069.easyPrerequisites:
You control an untapped land.
Ley Druid doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3430-4348-7069.description:
Activate a land by using the land granted to it by Tectonic Split by tapping it, adding nine mana of any color due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ley Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

728-1445-2267-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
728-1445-2267-4871.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

728-1981-2415-5931.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Funeral Room and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

620-2111-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2073-4050-6808-7878.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is 12 or less.
2073-4050-6808-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning The Last Ride from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When The Last Ride enters, Kolodin triggers, causing The Last Ride to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing The Last Ride.
When The Last Ride dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

372-2292-4783.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Abdel Adrian, scrying 1.
Choose to have Abdel Adrian returned to the command zone from your graveyard.
Hellkite Courser returns to the battlefield from exile, triggering itself, putting Abdel Adrain from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Hellkite Courser and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each exiled permanent.
Repeat.

643-2837-7827.description:
Cast Thorin by paying {3}{R}{W}.
When Thorin enters, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste due to Jinnie Fay.
When the Cat enters as a Dwarf due to Maskwood Nexus, Thorin triggers, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste due to Jinnie Fay.
Repeat step 3.

240-4452-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Rukarumel, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-4452-5256.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

141-5726.manaNeeded: {5}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
141-5726.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
141-5726.description:
Cast Three Steps Ahead by paying {U} plus another {3} to select its second mode, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Three Steps Ahead, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Three Steps Ahead, creating a token copy of Naru Meha.
Put either Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.
141-5726.notes: If desired, you can spend an additional {2} while casting Three Steps Ahead to add its third mode, allowing you to draw your library and then discard half that many cards.

375-4508-7223.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
375-4508-7223.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Hedron Detonator triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Hedron Detonator is a Pirate due to Stalactite Dagger, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Hedron Detonator triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Hedron Detonator trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

2781-4605-5987.description:
Cast Angel of Indemnity by paying its mana cost.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Felidar Guardian enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking another permanent you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Felidar Guardian that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Felidar Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 3.

851-1563-2457-7175.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2034-5003-7180.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Silvergill Mentor, adding {C}{C}.
When Silvergill Mentor dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Silvergill Mentor from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Silvergill Mentor enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

967-2921-3809-4365-7087.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

2719-7009-7068.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
2719-7009-7068.description:
Activate Sakashima using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Baboon Spirit by paying {3}{U}, exiling Sakashima.
At the beginning of your end step, Baboon Spirit triggers, returning Sakashima from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

539-2921-7008.description:
Cast Badgermole Cub by paying its mana cost
When Badgermole Cub enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Badgermole Cub
When Badgermole Cub dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Badgermole Cub enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

862-4050-4763--21.description:
Activate the Equipment by paying its equip cost, attaching it to Crimson Kobolds.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds, adding {R}.
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Koll triggers, returning Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2060-2350-4770-6930.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

1404-2506-4050-6925.description:
Cast Dusk Legion Sergeant by paying {1}{B}.
When Dusk Legion Sergeant enters, Molten Echoes triggers, creating a token copy of Dusk Legion Sergeant with haste.
Activate the token Dusk Legion Sergeant by sacrificing it.
When the Dusk Legion Sergeant token dies, Cordial Vampire triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each Vampire you control.
Resolve the token Dusk Legion Sergeant's ability, giving nontoken Vampires you control persist until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nontoken Vampire with base toughness 2 or higher, adding {1}.
When the Vampire dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the Vampire enters, Molten Echoes triggers, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dusk Legion Sergeant, adding {B}.
When Dusk Legion Sergeant dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
1404-2506-4050-6925.notes: You may repeat steps 6 through 8 as many times as desired to get infinite token copies of nontoken Vampires you control with base toughness 2 or greater. You can omit the additional Vampire if you control a static effect that boosts your creatures' toughness by 1 or more.

431-851-1308-2557.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-851-1308-2557.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

1921-2034-2534.description:
Activate Tawnos's second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it and sacrificing two artifact tokens, exiling Coercive Recruiter from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When the Coercive Recruiter token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Tawnos's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Coercive Recruiter token and causing you to mill two cards.
When the Coercive Recruiter token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Coercive Recruiter token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

5394-6291-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1651-2073-2981-6757--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the noncreature artifact with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the noncreature artifact enters the battlefield, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the noncreature artifact returned in step 1 and the Munitions token, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the noncreature artifact.
Repeat.
1651-2073-2981-6757--90.notes: You can sacrifice the Munitions to get infinite damage if desired. If the noncreature artifact chosen can sacrifice itself without tapping or additional costs, you can omit the sacrifice outlet, but will forego the possibility of infinite damage.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

3097-4506-5641.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Auriok Champion trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

2665-3617-4863.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Revolutionist.
2665-3617-4863.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Revolutionist.
When the token Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1115-1170-1328-4251.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant card exiled by Spellbinder's imprint ability that has legal targets, if needed.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Spellbinder attached to any Samurai you control.
1115-1170-1328-4251.description:
Declare Godo and the creature with Spellbinder attached as attackers.
Godo's second ability triggers, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control, and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, causing you to copy a card exiled with it, and cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Godo.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the spell cast in step 4.
Repeat each combat phase.

1115-1374-3626-5499--24.notablePrerequisites:
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1115-1374-3626-5499--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

1636-2527-4050-5489-5490.notablePrerequisites:
Zellix does not have summoning sickness.
Pith Driller does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
1636-2527-4050-5489-5490.description:
Activate Zellix by paying {1} and tapping it.
Haunted One triggers, causing all Horrors you control to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Zellix ability, causing a player to mill three cards.
If the player milled a creature card this way, Zellix triggers, creating a 1/1 Horror creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Pith Driller, adding {1}.
When Pith Driller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Pith Driller enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Pith Driller trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

508-1656-4283-4840.notablePrerequisites:
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two additional creatures.
It is your upkeep.
508-1656-4283-4840.description:
During your upkeep, activate Necrotic Ooze using Whisper's ability by tapping it and sacrificing two other creatures, returning Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Black Carriage's ability by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere, untapping Necrotic Ooze.
Repeat.

190-202-1695-4591.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Lich and causing each opponent to create a token copy of Lich, and lose life equal to their life totals due to Lich's effect.
You cannot lose the game due to having 0 or less life due to Platinum Angel.
Cast Essence Filter by paying {1}{G}{G}, destroying all enchantments.
Each opponent's Lich triggers, causing them to lose the game.

1171-1653-1656-4762.notablePrerequisites: Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
1171-1653-1656-4762.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Garth One-Eye's ability by tapping it, causing you to pay {0} to cast a copy of Black Lotus.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Garth One-Eye's ability by tapping it, causing you to pay {1}{G} to cast a copy of Regrowth.
Resolve Regrowth, returning Garth One-Eye to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Tireless Tribe's ability by discarding Garth One-Eye, giving Necrotic Ooze +0/+4 until end of turn.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite {G}, you may sacrifice Black Lotus for any other color of mana, and use that to cast any other spells from Garth One-Eye's ability.

1173-1984-2455-3454.manaNeeded: {3}{R}{W} the first turn, with {12}{R}{R}{W}{W} available each extra turn
1173-1984-2455-3454.notablePrerequisites: Sunforger attached to a creature you control.
1173-1984-2455-3454.description:
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Final Fortune and casting it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Final Fortune, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Reito Sentinel by paying {3}, putting Final Fortune on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to a creature you control.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to a creature you control.
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Angel's Grace and casting it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Angel's Grace, preventing you from losing the game this turn.
Activate Reito Sentinel by paying {3}, putting Angel's Grace on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your end step, Final Fortune triggers, however you cannot lose the game due to Angel's Grace.
Repeat from step 4.

1283-1661-1987-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Chromatic Orrery by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Chromatic Orrery.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1636-1684.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {R}.
1636-1684.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {R}.
Activate Rakka Mar by paying {R} and tapping it, creating a 3/1 Elemental creature token with haste.
When the Elemental enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2882-3661-4675.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
2882-3661-4675.description:
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Shield Sphere enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Shield Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

335-1984-2836.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, cast Angel's Grace by paying {W}, preventing you from losing the game this turn.
Cast Ad Nauseam by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Resolve Ad Nauseam, revealing the top card of your library, putting that card into your hand and losing life equal to that card's mana value.
Repeat the process in step 3 until you have an empty library.
On your draw step, Laboratory Maniac triggers, winning you the game.
